subject: beodeul_town_wall

criteriaNotes.same_game: Neutral grey ashlar with 3-4 step shading, speckle texture and a single dark indigo outline sits comfortably next to the original half-timbered/stone houses and matches the grey brick walls of the original walled-market render. Terracotta tower roofs reuse the house roof red/orange ramp with the same dotted tile texture. Wall blocks are larger and flatter than the house textures (lower texture density), but at 1x-3x this reads as a deliberate masonry scale, not a different chipset.
criteriaNotes.view_34: North wall: crenellated parapet on the outer (north) edge of a visible beige walkway plane, inner face below (test-map-3x y~145-285). South wall: walkway plane with merlon row on its south edge then outer face (y~915-1050). West/east walls show only walkway tops with a merlon strip on the outer edge. Gatehouse tops show a crenellated top plane; towers show front face plus pyramid roof, projecting ~5px in front of the wall line with a drop shadow on the wall to the right. No oblique or isometric side faces anywhere. End caps (west gap upper segment, T stubs) correctly show a short south-facing front face.
criteriaNotes.seamless_joins: Inspected at 8x: corners, T-junctions (the north-wall cross wall walkway cuts the face cleanly in parts-scene x~385-430), end caps, gatehouse-to-wall and tower-to-wall joins all have a continuous outline and matching parapet bands. Stairs in the north wall face have outlines on both sides and meet the walkway. Only sub-pixel polish issues remain (see minor). Nothing a player would notice as a broken line at 1x-3x.
criteriaNotes.gate_readable: At 1x the south gate is a dark arched opening with a portcullis fringe and the cobble road running out below. The north gate is a brown banded double door that blocks the road, which reads as closed. The west gap is a clean cut with an end-cap face above and the road passing through, so it reads as an opening.
criteriaNotes.readability_1x: At 1x the whole reads as a crenellated stone town wall with corner/flank towers and two gatehouses around the village. Face height (~2 cells) and tower height are plausible next to the 1-storey houses, and the original reference uses a similar wall-to-house ratio.

minor: Stairs on the north inner face are pale pink-beige with low contrast against the walkway. At 1x they read as faint stripes. Darken each tread's lower edge by one shade (use the face mortar colour) so the steps read as climbable.
Concave corner (kit-wall_parts-4x around x~805-830, y~640): the face's left outline ends with a 1px dark spur jutting right at the bottom of the first course. Remove the spur pixel.

Convex south-wall-to-vertical corner (kit-wall_parts-4x around x~385-405, y~1190-1215): the last merlon overlaps the vertical walkway by ~1 source px and leaves a darker shading column. Stop the merlon row one pixel earlier, or end it with the walkway's light edge colour.

South gatehouse: the road ends at the gatehouse's north top edge and the top plane draws over it, so from the inside the road appears to stop at a wall. A 1-2px darker threshold strip on the inner (north) edge of the gatehouse top above the arch would hint at the passage. This is optional.

Wall blocks are noticeably larger and flatter than the house textures. Adding one or two more speckle or crack pixels per block would raise the texture density toward the houses. This is a taste issue, not a failure.
